name: residential_average_life_expectancy
description: Test 11 through states 11, 4 and 12 on an 8 x 8 city (2 x 2 tracts). The LE curve is the identity (0, 0)(200, 200) and both decays are 0, so with no pollution the tracts keep HQ 61 and 75 and LE = HQ. Tract (0, 0): steady (100, 0, 0) at HQ 61; tract (1, 0): steady (300, 0, 0) at HQ 75. State 11 clears leSum and the running population; state 4 adds LE x total per tract: leSum = 61 x 100 + 75 x 300 = 28600, running population 400. State 12 sets the population to 400 and records 0x2A5E7009 = 28600 / 400 = 71 (unsigned 64-bit division, truncated).
